name: Dali

queries.query: Dali China cadastral parcel map official natural resources public map service GIS land registry
queries.result: An official Dali Prefecture Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page was found. It assigns the bureau responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying, registration-information platform management, and geospatial-result management. No Dali-specific anonymous parcel geometry API was found in the bounded search.

queries.result: The official Dali City government real-estate-registration section is live and its article metadata identifies the Dali City Natural Resources Bureau and Dali City Real Estate Registration Center as publishers. Official reporting also references a land-space-planning one-map supervision system, but no public cadastral parcel layer, service endpoint, schema, CRS response, or safe native parcel identifier was exposed.

sourceAssessment.officialCustodian: Dali Prefecture Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, with Dali City Natural Resources Bureau and Dali City Real Estate Registration Center evidenced by official government pages and registration-section metadata.
sourceAssessment.officialOpenServiceLead: Dali City government real-estate-registration section and the prefecture natural-resources one-map/planning references; no public parcel feature service was verified.
sourceAssessment.registryBasis: Official first-party government material directly evidences the local natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodians and their cadastral/registration responsibilities. This is registry evidence, not evidence of an open anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dali City cadastral and real-estate-registration custody is evidenced by official local and prefecture government sources; public machine-readable parcel coverage is unverified.

blocker: The official Dali pages loaded anonymously, but the bounded requests exposed only government content/article metadata and no current public parcel map/API route, layer schema, CRS, safe native parcel ID, or geometry response.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point is a research locator only. No exact-point hit or miss was used as evidence of citywide parcel absence; urban coverage, service authentication behavior, and native identifier fields remain unverified.
nextStep: Retry from any officially documented Dali cadastral or real-estate-registration viewer when a public route is identified; inspect its current JavaScript/configuration and query only a small Dali-area extent for geometry plus a safe native parcel identifier before adapter qualification.
